notablePrerequisites:
Ajani Steadfast has at least three loyalty counters on it.
Ajani, the Greathearted has at least two loyalty counters on it.
Teferi has at least eight loyalty counters on it.
description:
Activate Ajani Steadfast's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, putting a loyalty counter on each other planeswalker you control.
Activate Ajani, the Greathearted's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, putting a loyalty counter on each other planeswalker you control.
Activate Nicol-Bolas using Ajani Steadfast's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, putting a loyalty counter on each other planeswalker you control.
Activate Teferi's third loyalty ability by removing ten loyalty counters from it, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Activate Aminatou's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, blinking Teferi.
Activate Teferi's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing you to loot.
Move to your first extra turn.
Activate Teferi's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing you to loot.
Repeat steps 1-3 one additional time.
Move to your second extra turn.
Repeat.
